section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes the instruments used to assess body appreciation (BAS), caregiver eating messages (CEMS), adult attachment (ECRS), perfectionism (APS-R), depressive symptoms (BDI-II), intuitive eating (IES), and body mass index (BMI). Participants self-reported their weight and height, which were converted to calculate BMI (M = 23.1, SD = 4.8 kg/m²). The section documents the reliability and validity of each measure for the current sample.
